description: Risk-band-scaled multipliers applied to the PvE cooperative partner's stats.

Id.technical: FName import key/row name for FGameDataTableRow_PvEAllyParameter. GamePvE_GetAllyParameter enumerates all rows of PvEAllyParameterDataTables (DTM+0x960) and selects by Id_GlobalThreshold, so the id itself is not used as a lookup key in the observed consumer.

Id_GlobalThreshold.simple: Risk-value band that selects this parameter row.
Id_GlobalThreshold.technical: FName, default None. For each ally row the consumer resolves a FGameDataTableRow_GlobalThreshold in GlobalThresholdDataTables (DTM+0x300) and tests RiskValue against its Min/Max with inclusive bounds. The first matching row is returned; a missing threshold or a risk outside every band leaves the ally pointer null and no multipliers are applied. Exported rows share one id with their row name.

HitPointMaxRate.simple: Multiplier for the partner's maximum hit points.
HitPointMaxRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f (data supplies values such as 1.0-1.4). GamePvE_CalcHitPoint starts from Growth->HitPointMaxRate (or 1.0), multiplies by this ally rate, then applies equipment/vow terms and floors the final HP at 1.0. This calculation is used for the player/partner in PvE solo and interval setup; enemy HP uses MissionCharacter.HitPoint instead.

CursedEnergyExpAddRate.simple: Partner multiplier for cursed-energy experience gain.
CursedEnergyExpAddRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f. In PvE solo battle entry construction for slot 1 (the AI partner), the consumer adds (rate - 1.0f) to Setup.StatusSetup.Rates.CursedEnergyExp, which starts at 1.0; growth-row contributions are added on top. Slot 0 (local player) does not receive ally-parameter rates.

CursedEnergyRecoverRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f. Applied only to slot 1 in PvE solo as (rate - 1.0f) added to StatusSetup.Rates.CursedEnergyRecover before growth contributions.

GuardDurabilityMaxRate.simple: Partner multiplier for maximum guard durability.
GuardDurabilityMaxRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f. Applied only to slot 1 as an additive (rate - 1.0f) adjustment to StatusSetup.Rates.GuardDurabilityMax; downstream guard-durability maxima are derived from the status controller and battle team rate.

DashGaugeMaxRate.simple: Partner multiplier for maximum dash gauge.
DashGaugeMaxRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f. Applied only to slot 1 as (rate - 1.0f) added to StatusSetup.Rates.DashGaugeMax; later dash-gauge clamping uses Owner->GetDashGaugeMaxRate() times the dash gauge base value.

DamageRate.simple: Partner multiplier for sent attack damage.
DamageRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f. Applied only to slot 1 as (rate - 1.0f) added to StatusSetup.Rates.SendAttackDamage; the resulting rate feeds the character's damage calculation.

notes: The exported asset has 5 rows with FGameDataTableRow_PvEAllyParameter; the manager loads PvEAllyParameterDataTable into PvEAllyParameterDataTables (DTM+0x960). No localization variants or numbered shards were supplied.

Ally-parameter rate bonuses are applied to the partner slot only in the observed battle-entry code (GamePhase_BattlePvESolo); the interval phase uses the row only for partner HP calculation. Tag mode uses growth rows but not an ally-parameter lookup.
Row defaults are 0.0f in the reconstructed struct ctor, while the rate system's neutral baseline is 1.0f; exported data supplies explicit multipliers, so a serialized 0 would not mean neutral.
Selection helper 0x1303d20 and related functions are reconstructed; consult status/functions.json for byte status. Content is partial and Blueprint uses were not exhaustively inspectable.

usages.detail: GamePvE_GetAllyParameter selects the first row whose global risk threshold contains the current risk value.
Applies five partner rate fields to the co-op AI's battle setup.
GamePvE_CalcHitPoint multiplies the growth rate by HitPointMaxRate and adds equipment/vow modifiers.
Interval PvE uses the ally row together with growth data to compute partner maximum HP.
